description: Zero‑dependency, type‑safe Node.js framework that feels like Express, runs at Fastify speed, and ships native HTTP/2 & edge‑runtime support for AI‑augmented serverless workloads.
npm_trending_strategy: Leverage the surge in AI‑augmented serverless apps by positioning yantravese as the only zero‑dependency, fully type‑safe framework that natively supports HTTP/2, edge runtimes (Bun, Deno, Cloudflare Workers, Vercel), and built‑in LLM/GenAI hooks. Emphasize benchmarked 2× speed over Express and 1.3× over Fastify, plus out‑of‑the‑box OpenAPI & tRPC generation, making it the go‑to choice for modern full‑stack teams hunting low‑latency, edge‑first deployments.
download_hooks: Developers pick yantravese for its zero‑dependency footprint—no extra packages to audit or bundle.
Performance angle: Benchmarks show 2× faster request handling than Express and 30% lower latency than Fastify on HTTP/2 edge nodes.
Developer experience angle: Full TypeScript inference, automatic OpenAPI & tRPC schema generation, and built‑in AI middleware let teams ship features in hours instead of days.
